name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.passesL_iff
typeText:
∀ (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance) (n : Nat) [inst : NeZero.{0} n]
  (hv : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.Valid g) (tabs : List.{0} (List.{0} Nat)),
  (∀ (t : List.{0} Nat), Membership.mem.{0, 0} tabs t → ∀ (v : Nat), Membership.mem.{0, 0} t v → LT.lt.{0} v n) →
    ∀ (a : List.{0} Nat),
      (∀ (v : Nat), Membership.mem.{0, 0} a v → LT.lt.{0} v n) →
        Iff (Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.passesL g n tabs a) Bool.true)
          (DisequalityDispersion.Valid (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.tests g hv)
            (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.tabInterp (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g) n tabs)
            (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.listAssign (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g) n a))

source.code:
theorem GInstance.passesL_iff (tabs : List (List ℕ)) (htabs : ∀ t ∈ tabs, ∀ v ∈ t, v < n)
    (a : List ℕ) (ha : ∀ v ∈ a, v < n) :
    g.passesL n tabs a = true ↔
      DisequalityDispersion.Valid (g.tests hv) (tabInterp g.base n tabs) (g.base.listAssign n a) := by
  unfold GInstance.tests
  rw [← g.base.passesTests_iff (g.baseValid hv) _ _ ⟨0, NeZero.pos n⟩]
  unfold GInstance.passesL Instance.passesTests
  rw [g.base.evalNodesL_eq n (g.baseValid hv) tabs htabs a ha]
  simp only [List.all_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  simp only [getD_map_val (NeZero.pos n)]
  constructor
  · intro h ij hij he
    exact h ij hij (by rw [he])
  · intro h ij hij he
    exact h ij hij (Fin.ext he)
